As an independent shop, we service all makes and models of semi-trucks, box trucks, fleet vehicles, and heavy equipment. Whether you need stainless steel tanker, fiberglass, collision, or trailer repairs, our team has the training, experience, and equipment to tackle anything from a minor dent to a complete rebuild. At Florida Truck and Trailer, we know the financial costs of having your truck off the road. Because of this, we concentrate on delivering high-quality work as quickly as possible. Since our opening in 1970, our commitment has always been to provide quality services at affordable prices. This dedication to our customers has helped us grow Florida Truck and Trailer into one of the state’s largest heavy equipment repair facilities. | Centrally located in Bartow, our shop spans over 25,000 square feet and is equipped with a Blackhawk Power Cage Frame Machine that can straighten any truck or trailer frame. Our paint shop features two full-size truck spray booths capable of accommodating vehicles up to sixty feet in length. Our trailer shop specializes in repairing food-grade stainless steel tank trailers, reefers, flatbeds, and dry van trailers. | Over the past 50 years, we are proud to say that we have repaired thousands of trucks and fleet vehicles from all over Florida.
